newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Kolinska down after share issue.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Kolinska down after share issue.

text.p: Shares in food producer Kolinska fell 3.54 percent to 1,910 tolars in Ljubljana on Monday after it listed 650,977 new shares.

"The price was down due to the extension of listed shares which could cause the price to ease to about 1,900 or even 1,850 tolars in the next couple of days," said Davor Dubokovic, a trader of Eastbrokers.
Kolinska now has 3,248,048 shares listed in Ljubljana, representing 91.0 percent of its equity.
Some market participants said Monday's price fall was a knee jerk reaction and forecast a recovery in the longer term.
"Kolinska has relatively good business results so the share price is expected to rise...Now may be a good time to buy it," one broker said.
